Can Bujo be used to call Reins of Power from another methuselah's ash
heap if it's already been called that game?

IIRC, Reins of Power reads "only 1 Reins of Power may be played in a
game", which means you can't Charming Lobby a second one ("play that
card" by CL's text), but Bujo doesn't say that you play that card,
merely that you call the referendum listed on it.

Does that fly?

John
